title: Extend API routes for premium seeder with dry-run, import, and template download endpoints
description: Add new API endpoints to support the premium seeder workflow: POST /premium-seeder/dry-run (preview without commit), POST /premium-seeder/import (commit after dry-run confirmation), and GET /premium-seeder/template (download blank Excel template). Extend existing POST /premium-import-excel route or add dedicated route group in payroll.ts.

files.change: Add ElysiaJS route group with three endpoints: POST /dry-run (accepts Excel file + period_month + period_year + division_code + premium_type, returns PremiumDryRunSummary), POST /import (accepts Excel file + dryRunConfirmationId + period params, returns PremiumImportResult with progress), GET /template (accepts premium_type query param, returns .xlsx file buffer).

implementation: POST /dry-run: accept file buffer, period_month, period_year, division_code, premium_type via t.Object() body validation. Delegate to dryRunPremiumExcel(). Return PremiumDryRunSummary.

POST /import: accept file buffer, period_month, period_year, division_code, premium_type. Validate dry-run was performed (require dryRunConfirmationId or flag). Delegate to importPremiumExcel(). Return PremiumImportResult with progress.

GET /template: accept premium_type query param (optional, defaults to all blok types). Delegate to generatePremiumTemplate(). Set response headers: Content-Type: application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, Content-Disposition: attachment; filename='template_premi_{type}.xlsx'.
Add rate limiter to write endpoints (POST /import) using existing rateLimiter middleware
Add auth requirement (existing auth middleware applies to route group)
Add Elysia t.Object() schemas for request body validation on each endpoint
Handle errors: 400 for missing file/invalid params, 422 for validation failures, 500 for service errors

reference.pattern: payroll.ts L3487-L3536 existing POST /premium-import-excel with file buffer handling, dynamic import, error handling
reference.examples: payroll.ts L3487-L3513 shows: dynamic import of service, Buffer.from(file.data), period params from query, service.getInstance(), try/catch with set.status. Follow same structure for new endpoints.

criteria: POST /premium-seeder/dry-run returns PremiumDryRunSummary with row-by-row action classification
POST /premium-seeder/import writes to payroll_manual_adjustments and returns PremiumImportResult with progress
GET /premium-seeder/template returns valid .xlsx buffer with correct Content-Type header
All endpoints protected by auth middleware
Write endpoints protected by rate limiter

rationale.chosen_approach: New /premium-seeder route group with dedicated endpoints for dry-run, import, and template download. Clean separation from existing /premium-import-excel route. Follows ElysiaJS group pattern.
alternatives_considered: Extend existing /premium-import-excel with query params for dry-run/template
Separate route file (premiumSeederRoutes.ts) instead of payroll.ts
decision_factors: API clarity: separate endpoints for separate concerns
Consistency: payroll.ts already hosts premium-related routes
rationale.tradeoffs: Slightly more routes to maintain but clearer API surface. Route group keeps endpoints organized without needing new file.

manual_checks: Call POST /premium-seeder/dry-run with valid Excel, verify 200 and correct summary
Call POST /premium-seeder/import without dry-run first, verify 400 error
Call endpoints without auth token, verify 401
success_metrics: 3 endpoints return correct status codes for valid requests
Error responses include descriptive error messages
Rate limiter rejects >N requests/minute on write endpoints
